- `name` (string) - Name is the extension name; it becomes the image/directory name on the
  guest and the release-file name.

- `source` (string) - Source is a local path: either a directory (packaged by the plugin) or
  a prebuilt .raw disk image uploaded as-is.

- `format` (string) - Format is the packaging format for directory sources: "directory"
  (default), "squashfs", or "erofs". It is ignored for .raw sources.

- `release_file` (string) - ReleaseFile is a user-supplied extension-release file that overrides
  auto-generation. Directory sources only.
